entity: Snapfinger Creek sewer plant (DeKalb County, GA): heavy overflows against small penalties
what_we_add: The plant-level counts: 1,394 overflows since Oct 2016, $52,344 in penalties (~$38 each), 202 overflows in 2025. Sources report spills and county-level fines, never these numbers.
why: The Champion and Decaturish name Snapfinger and report ongoing overflows there, including 9.2M- and 7M-gallon spills — same entity, same finding in words. County-wide consent-decree penalties ($859K, $294K) have a different scope than our plant-only $52,344, so they don't line up as a contradiction.
